thread:
sam: Heads up — BluePraxis (BPX-442) flagged an overcharge on INV-2026-03-17. Promo 'bulk-onboarding-50' didn't apply for 3/14-3/16 usage. Can finance review for a retro credit?

marta: Thanks @sam. Can you paste the invoice line and the expected promo amount?

sam: Invoice: INV-2026-03-17. Lines: 
- bulk_ingest_ingress: 12,000 units @ $0.05 = $600
They expected 50% off for onboarding -> should be $300 credit.

raj: I looked at the ingestion tagging logs. The promo flag didn't attach for 3/14 due to a race in the provisioning hook — batch job failed to set customer.promos in time. Example log:```
2026-03-14T02:11:07Z ERROR provisioning-hook: promo-tag missing for customer BPX-442 request_id=abc123
```

billing-bot: Ticket created FIN-4591 for merchant credit request (linked to INV-2026-03-17).

marta: Ok — looks like a valid retro promo miss. Per policy we can issue a promo credit plus an optional goodwill if needed. How much total to propose?

sam: Customer is on a growth plan, long-term partner. I'd propose the $300 promo credit + $50 goodwill to preserve relationship (total $350).

emily: @marta can approve up to $500 for partner retention. I need a short justification string for the ledger note and GL code.

marta: Justification: "Retroactive onboarding promo missed due to provisioning race; customer impacted 3/14-3/16. Promo credit $300 + goodwill $50. Approved by finance lead emily." GL code: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

emily: Approved. :thumbsup: Please attach FIN-4591 and update the invoice notes.

marta: Doing it now. Creating credit memo CM-2026-038 for $350, linking to INV-2026-03-17 and FIN-4591. Posting to ledger with GL SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-038 created and applied to INV-2026-03-17. Refund not required (applied as credit).

raj: I'll patch the provisioning hook to add a guard and add a nightly reconciliation to catch untagged days. Opening infra PR and will link it to FIN-4591.

marta: Please add the reconciliation job runbook to the ticket so we can show remediation for audit.

sam: Customer notified — they confirmed receipt and appreciate the quick turnaround.

emily: Good handling team. Mark FIN-4591 as "resolved — credit applied" and include follow-ups in next finance ops review.

marta: Done. FIN-4591 moved to resolved, CM-2026-038 attached, notes updated. Thanks everyone.

sam: Thanks all :pray:

emily: Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
